changes.comment: `DispatcherSubmitCommand` is exported: the flat Channel-facing submit payload — display attributes, faithful text, an optional trailing reminder, and an optional `source_id` Core deduplicates on — with no recipient in it, because `dispatcher.submit` addresses the Dispatcher through the caller context. `TeamSubmitCommand` extends it with a required `team_name` and the optional `intent`, so omitting the Team name no longer type-checks and no longer means the Dispatcher Agent.
